ns2:course.label: Leadership and Problem Solving
ns2:course.description: Fundamentals of small unit military operations including operations planning, military orders, troop leading procedures, small unit offensive and defensive operations. Includes field practical application. Prerequisite: Successful completion of MILS 101, MILS 102, MILS 201 and MILS 202 is required to enroll in MILS 301.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Successful completion of MILS 101, MILS 102, MILS 201 and MILS 202 is required to enroll in MILS 301.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Examines basic skills that underlie effective problem solving.
